spirit.title: The spirit of the network
spirit.body:
DIASPORA.GA is the network of Gabonese citizens living abroad: people help one another here, keep their associations alive and find a skill close to home. These rules apply to everything published and exchanged here, in every country: posts, comments, messages, profiles and pages.

They come down to three ideas: respect people, tell the truth, protect the most exposed. What the law prohibits offline is prohibited here, and these rules form part of the Terms of use.

Everyone is responsible for what they publish, share or relay. Relaying illegal content is also answering for it.

respect.title: Respect and harassment

scams.title: Scams, fake services and false information

impersonation.title: Impersonation
impersonation.body:
Do not pass yourself off as another person, an association, a company, a consular post or a State institution. Impersonating an identity is an offence, made worse by the use of artificial intelligence.

A page speaks in the name of the organisation it presents, and only a verified member can register one. Imitating the visual or sound identity of a State institution in order to deceive is prohibited; a report of such content is handled within 24 hours (Ordinance No. 0011/PR/2026, Article 32).

Badges are calculated by the service: none can be bought or declared. A consular attestation proves a consular registration, never a professional skill.

politics.title: Political debate
politics.body:
Debate of ideas is allowed, with respect for people: you can criticise a policy, a decision or an institution. Insults, calls to hatred or violence, impersonation and paid political advertising are not.

During an election period as at any other time, do not publish false information about a vote, its dates or how to vote.

Moderation applies the same rules to all opinions: DIASPORA.GA is the mouthpiece of no party and no authority.

privacy.title: Privacy, image and reputation of others
privacy.body:
Do not publish, without their consent, another person’s address, telephone number, e-mail address, photo, voice or personal situation, nor the content of a private conversation or a screenshot of it.

Do not damage a person’s reputation: do not put forward a fact you cannot establish, and do not settle a private dispute in public.

Be especially careful with children: do not publish a child’s photo without the consent of their parents, nor anything that makes it possible to locate them.

Never publish an identity document, a passport number or a consular document, whether your own or another person’s.

prohibited.title: Prohibited content

authorship.title: Copyright and other people’s content
authorship.body:
Publish only what you have the right to publish: your own texts, photos, videos and music, or those whose author has given you permission. Cite your sources.

Do not distribute a pirated work (film, match, music, book, software) and do not use another person’s name, logo or brand to suggest a link that does not exist.

If one of your works is reused without your permission, report it by choosing “Other reason” and stating your request, or write to the publisher.

integrity.title: Authenticity and security of the network
integrity.body:
One account per person: no fake accounts, no accounts that are lent, rented or sold, and no second account to bypass a measure.

Do not clutter the network: no bulk messages, chain messages, repeated posts, unsolicited canvassing through messaging, or purchase of connections or reactions.

Use no robot and no automatic collection tool, and do not try to access what is not open to you. If you discover a flaw, write to the publisher without exploiting it.

Technical limits protect the network: number of links per post, writing rate, blocked terms. Content that exceeds them may be refused or held for review.

pages.title: Pages and groups

reporting.title: Reporting
reporting.body:
Every post, comment, profile and page has a “Report” action, like the other content on the network. Choose the reason and give details if needed: the network’s moderation team examines the report, and the person reported does not know who reported them.

The reported content is hidden for you straight away; a review of a service, however, stays displayed until the decision. You immediately receive an acknowledgement of receipt, then the decision: you can find them in “My reports”.

Some time limits are set by Ordinance No. 0011/PR/2026. They apply whatever your country of residence:

– harassment and content harmful to a minor: decision notified within 72 hours (Article 24);
– deepfake of a person, reported by that person: removal within 24 hours (Article 33);
– prohibited artificial intelligence content and imitation of a State institution: handled within 24 hours (Article 32).

Other reports are examined in the order they arrive, with no time limit set by law.

A profile is shared by DIASPORA.GA and ANTSIA: its report is examined by ANTSIA moderation.

Report in good faith: repeated and unfounded reports may themselves lead to a measure. A report does not alert the emergency services: in the event of immediate danger, call the emergency services of the country where you are.
